starts without this one's messages.

reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

from scipy.spatial import ConvexHull
pts=np.argwhere(a==6) # r,c
h=ConvexHull(pts)
# equations Ax+by+c<=0 inside
coords=np.indices((16,16)).reshape(2,-1).T
inside=np.all(coords@h.equations[:,:2].T + h.equations[:,2] <=1e-8,axis=1).reshape(16,16)
print('b2 outside hull',np.sum((b==2)&~inside),'b8 inside hull',np.sum((b==8)&inside))
print('inside rows')
for r in range(16): print(r,''.join('2' if inside[r,c] and a[r,c]==8 else '6' if a[r,c]==6 else '.' for c in range(16)))
